model.name: Les Paul Standard
model.description: A Les Paul Standard from the late 1980s, representing a period of renewed focus on classic Gibson designs.

individual_guitar.significance_notes: A primary touring guitar for Slash since the late 1980s. Used extensively during the 'Use Your Illusion' era and throughout his career.
individual_guitar.modifications: Extensive modifications including a repaired headstock break, replaced tuners, and a variety of pickup changes over the years.
individual_guitar.provenance_notes: Gifted to Slash by Gibson in 1988. Has been a constant touring and recording companion for over three decades.
